main_measure.name: pooled excess 5-bar forward return after extreme bars (forecast <= -10) minus coin's window drift
main_measure.threshold: confirm: pooled excess < 0 with t <= -2 and negative in >= 2 coins; reject: pooled excess >= 0, or negative in < 2 coins with t > -1; min 30 pooled non-overlapping extreme blocks and 8 per coin

supporting_check.name: Spearman rank correlation of |forecast| with next 5-bar return, bars with forecast < 0

decided_by: The pooled excess return is negative with -2 < t <= -1.
reading: The coin's drift is the mean 5-bar forward return over the same non-overlapping grid (positions 0, 5, 10, ...) of each window, the per-coin sign is the mean excess over that coin's extreme blocks, the 'at least 2 of the 3 coins' rule is applied as at least 2 negative coins among the coins present, and the supporting correlation uses all bars with forecast < 0.
